g.text: 1. Will use websocket over HTTP request because of polling window, like server keep on asking the latest messages to server

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. When Alice or Bob will open Redis table will create a hashmap, like where alice is in which server, and bob is in which server because

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: we have multiple server to handle billion of request;

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. when searching Bob on server from Redis table, if he is no longer active will remove from Redis Table and message store in DB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and send push notification, if he is active it deliver message.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. When Bob opens conversation it call conversation/100/messages?pageSize=20, will define time as sort key so it will store DESC order when we scroll it load older 50 messages

g.text: 5. Once message send from Alice -> Bob, Bob server send ACK so it will update message from SENT -> Delivered, once he open conversation it changes to SEEN

g.text: 7. If Bob suddenly offline then server is active for 60 sec thats heartbeat period then turn it to offline.
